description: No key needed for tokens you already hold: pass tokens (up to 20) to see whether each is a preview waiting for its claim, claimed (download_vector works), expired or not found; this shows the state only, no files. With an API key, lists your conversions instead, newest first: token, file name, when it was made, when its files expire (30 days), the formats already made, and whether it is paid, a preview or a test. Free and read-only.

cursor.description: With a key: next_cursor from the previous call.

limit.description: With a key: how many to return.

tokens.description: Without a key: image tokens (img_…) to check, at most 20. Ignored when a key is sent.

name: list_conversions

tokens.description: Without a key: one entry per token asked about, in order.

keyless_download_until.description: Only for status claimed: download_vector works without a key until then.

price_credits.description: Credits the first download costs the claimer: 1, or 0 once paid.
